title: Transcript (Whisper segments)
description: Time-stamped dialogue segments produced by Whisper. Producer: audio/transcribe.py:main (tries faster-whisper first, falls back to openai-whisper).

backend.description: Which Whisper backend produced this transcript (auto-fallback resolved at run time by audio/transcribe.py).

segments.description: Ordered Whisper segments spanning [0, duration). Adjacent segments are contiguous (end_i == start_{i+1}) except for silence gaps.

end.description: Segment end time in seconds (must be > start).

text.description: Transcribed text for the segment (may be empty string for silence).
Full transcript text (concatenation of all segment texts).

duration.description: Source media duration in seconds (from ffprobe).

source.description: Original source video filename (basename, used for traceability).
